purpose: Plain-language handoff state for jonathanblunt1214-lgtm/Nexus-, so a different AI agent or a fresh session of the same agent can pick up work with full context. See AGENTS.md for the binding rules this file summarizes; this file is the human- and agent-readable index, not a separate source of authority.

agentCommunicationPolicy.appliesTo: Every attended progress or completion check-in message an AI agent sends to the repository owner while working on this repository.
agentCommunicationPolicy.summary: Plain language: before telling the owner about progress or that something is done, an AI must open that message with the current date and time written as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS followed by EDT or EST, e.g. 2026-08-28 08:10:42 EDT. This lets the owner tell how fresh a status update is at a glance, and lets a later session or agent reconstruct the real order of events across multiple AI agents working on the same repository.

aiConflictGovernance.summary: Plain language: if two AI agents, or two runs of the same agent, make changes that could clash, the clash gets written down as an entry in AI-CONFLICTS.json instead of one side silently overwriting the other. Any conflict entry that is still open or incomplete blocks The Crucible CI gate, so nothing can be promoted to main while a real conflict is unresolved. Nobody force-pushes, deletes, renames, or overwrites a branch to make a conflict go away; it gets resolved and recorded instead.

branchAuthoritySummary: Plain language: ordinary AI work happens only on Development-branch. An AI does not create or use claude/*, codex/*, or other auxiliary branches, and does not touch main directly, unless the repository owner explicitly authorizes that exact branch or operation in the current conversation — and that authorization does not carry over to the next task. main only changes through the protected promote-development-to-main.yml workflow. See AGENTS.md for the full, binding rules.
